blind_target.title: Meta-analysis Confirms CR1, CLU, and PICALM as Alzheimer Disease Risk Loci and Reveals Interactions With APOE Genotypes
blind_target.evidence_quote: In a recently published article an interaction between PICALM (rs3851179) and APOEε4 was reported (interaction OR=0.84, unadjusted p=0.0068), but not between CR1 (rs3818361) and APOEε4 (interaction OR=1.01, unadjusted p=0.28) [16].
blind_target.outcome_quote: The only nominally significant epistatic interactions reported to date are with the powerful APOE ε4 allele; the CR1 * APOEε4 interaction reported here and the PICALM * APOEε4 interaction reported previously. These two interactions were both weak and neither replicated.

luna_triage.reason: The Results directly retest the reported BIN1/EXOC3L2 risk-locus associations from Seshadri, while this candidate is Jun et al. [16], whose cited finding is the PICALM-by-APOE interaction. The Discussion directly compares that interaction with the present null result. The supplied row 221 is Seshadri et al. [6], a different original and does not represent Jun et al. [16].
luna_triage.omission_quote: In a recently published article an interaction between PICALM (rs3851179) and APOEε4 was reported (interaction OR=0.84, unadjusted p=0.0068), but not between CR1 (rs3818361) and APOEε4 (interaction OR=1.01, unadjusted p=0.28) [16]. In our study, the test for interaction between PICALM and APOEε4 was not significant (OR=0.97, unadjusted p=0.74);

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
